en.topic_title: 3 Hong Kong dog owners lose appeals against ‘fighting dog’ classifications
en.topic_summary:
Three dog owners have lost their appeal against the government’s decision to classify their pets as “fighting dogs,” designations that were made as authorities tightened regulations following fatal dog attacks in August.
